\chapter{The Third Form Line: Residence}
\label{ch:pa-form-residence}
\hlchaptermodality{19}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can select between two separately practised values and fill one requested Gurmukhi residence line from a nonverbal cue with no model.}

The learner fills one residence field from a nonverbal cue after selection, supported entry, spacing, delayed entry, and repair have each received a bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[two residence-value cues]{Select one known residence value}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-select}



\begin{quote}
Read the closed bank once:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — attach one cue to each value}
Point to A, then \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}. Point to B, then \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}. Cover the bank and say which value B requests. Selection is separate from spelling.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal, point, cover, and select once more. Do not write the form line yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
These cues belong only to this two-item bank.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[residence field]{Fill one supported residence field}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep this bank visible:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — model visible}
Complete \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for A. Read the label, select the A value, and copy it. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Compare selection, spelling, spacing, and placement in separate passes.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one supported line.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[residence field spacing]{Give the residence value its own space}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-spacing}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}. Point once to the label and once to the value.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one spacing pass}
Copy \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}:}, leave a clear space, then copy \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}. Judge only the boundary after the colon.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and repeat once. If the boundary is unclear, repair only the space.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Selection and memory are not scored in this spacing pass.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[residence field after a short delay]{Hide, wait, then fill the residence field}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Read A — \textbf{\pa{ਪਿੰਡ}}, B — \textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}} once. Hide the bank and count slowly to ten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — short delayed entry}
With the bank hidden, complete \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for B. Finish the attempt before revealing the bank.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal and compare selection, spelling, spacing, then placement. Do not repair yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One delayed line is enough.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[residence field repair]{Repair one residence-field difference}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-repair}



\begin{quote}
Compare \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}:\pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}} with \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}. The letters match; one boundary differs.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one repair pass}
Rewrite the first line with a clear space after the colon. Leave every letter unchanged.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Name the repaired dimension: selection, spelling, spacing, or placement. Stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next lesson asks for a fresh line rather than a repair.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[residence field]{One no-model residence field}

\label{lesson:PA-W04-residence-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close the previous lesson. There is no value bank, support-language label, or romanized answer below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the requested field:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਰਿਹਾਇਸ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the known value attached to A and write it from memory. Do not reopen an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare selection, spelling, spacing, and placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This closes only the residence-field ladder. The remaining form fields are separate backlog work.
\end{tcolorbox}
